match_rule: gnss_match = the first detected fall (magmatic or hidden_by_interpolation, deflation_events) starting on the onset's UTC day or up to 2 days later
boundary_rule: rows with boundary true bound the rooms and the waits at their boundary_day (the onset's UTC day); same-day events share one

intrusion_boundaries.modes: all = every intrusion; detected = only one with a matched GNSS fall of at least min_fall_mm on SKSH; none = eruptions only

gnss_match_share: 1 / the number of rows sharing the matched fall (each row's share of its size); null = no match

for_leif.what: the official fissure / dike traces for 8 Feb 2024, 29 May 2024 and the 10 Nov 2023, 2 Mar 2024 and 1 Apr 2025 intrusions (NI / IMO, gis.natt.is LMI_vektor:gos_Reykjanes_gangur and the fissure layer, unreachable 2026-10-25): they would replace the landmark-based approx places

rows.end_note: magma inflow into the 10 Nov dike 'has likely ceased' (IMO's geodetic modelling); no eruption
